title: The Laughs We Shared
synopsis: From the very start, we couldn't stop laughing together.
story:
Do you remember that ridiculous thing that happened? We couldn't stop laughing — the kind where your stomach hurts and tears stream down your face.

I knew right then that I wanted to laugh with you every single day.

You have the most beautiful laugh I've ever heard. It's still my favorite sound in the world.

title: Our First Date
synopsis: Three outfit changes later, and there you were.
story:
I changed my outfit three times before you picked me up. I was so nervous I could barely breathe. But the moment I saw your smile, everything melted away.

Dinner was wonderful, but the walk afterwards was magic. We talked for hours under the streetlights, not wanting the night to end.

That night, walking me to my door, I knew — this was something I never wanted to lose.

title: How We Met
synopsis: The universe brought us together and I'll never stop being grateful.
story:
It was one of those days that started out ordinary. I was going about my usual routine, completely unaware that my life was about to change.

But then you walked in. We talked like we had known each other forever — no awkwardness, no hesitation, just an instant connection that I still can't explain.

That day changed everything. You changed everything.

title: One Year Together
synopsis: 365 days of learning what love really means.
story:
One year. We made it look easy, but it was so much more than that.

We learned each other's languages — the way you need space when you're quiet, the way I need words when I'm scared. We grew not just closer, but stronger.

We celebrated with a quiet dinner and a walk under the stars. Here's to forever more of this.

title: Adventures Together
synopsis: No plan, no map — just us and the open road.
story:
We woke up on a Saturday and decided to just drive. No destination, no timeline, just each other and the wind.

We ended up at a place we'd never heard of. Watched the most beautiful sunset either of us had ever seen.

That's when I realized — getting lost with you is better than arriving anywhere without you.

title: Three Years
synopsis: 1096 days. A million moments. One love.
story:
Three years. One thousand and ninety-six days of waking up next to you, of falling asleep in your arms, of choosing each other again and again.

We've built something rare and beautiful. A love that feels like home, like safety, like the best part of every day.

I love you more today than yesterday. And tomorrow, I'll love you even more.

Happy anniversary, my everything.
